consumer: The offline map-dump writer (arcopolis_export write_tiles) which asks 'what is the raw terrain id at this tile?' and records it as ground truth, not as a displayed or filtered view.
scope: a map region: every nearby tile in the export window, independent of LOS/visibility
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles — its body emits ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() per tile, the raw authoritative terrain string id (e.g. t_floor), not a computed predicate or display proxy
divergence: A tile out of the character's line of sight still has a real terrain id (e.g. t_wall); a display-observability answer would report it as unknown/blank or as stale remembered terrain, whereas the raw map state ter(p) returns the true current id — the dump diverging from ter(p) there exposes the wrong answer.
